_comment: A1 gate: default-deny on structured ids. Display names are not consulted anywhere in the pipeline, so a nickname match cannot authorize anyone. Owner rule: at most one owner entry per channel (two owners in one channel is a policy error); a different owner id on another channel loads but is flagged at boot for review. Roles are owner|trusted; new entries need a review (docs/security/t2-security-baseline.md A1/A3).
